title: Pani Piyo
body:
sadaat pyase reh gaye
<<DIVIDER>>
pani piyo to yaad karo pyaas imam ki
pyason sabeel hai ye shaheedon ke naam ki
<<DIVIDER>>
khanjar talay hussain ko pani nahi mila
pyason karo qabool ye tohfa hussain ka
chaahat hai ye hussain alaihis salaam ki
pyason sabeel hai ye...
pani piyo to yaad karo...
<<DIVIDER>>
jannat mein kar chuka hai khuda jis ka ehtemam
kausar rakha hai aayat e kausar mein jis ka naam
jageer ye sabeel hai baara imam ki
pyason sabeel hai ye...
pani piyo to yaad karo...
<<DIVIDER>>
aati hai is sabeel pe ujdi wo bibiyan
yani ali o fatema zahra ki betiyan
ye bargah bhi hai shahe tishna kaam ki
pyason sabeel hai ye...
pani piyo to yaad karo...
<<DIVIDER>>
pani ka intezaar sakina se poochiye
asghar ki maa rabab e hazeena se poochiye
rasm e sabeel jis ne zamane mein aam ki
pyason sabeel hai ye...
pani piyo to yaad karo...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab karbala shanawar o salman jayenge
pyason ke naam par wahan pani pilayenge
zahra ki naukri hai ye khidmat imam ki
pyason sabeel hai ye...
pani piyo to yaad karo...
author: Salman Azmi
